name: Smoke plume morph
looks: A monochrome plume of smoke or ink curls and billows across the frame, and for a moment its drifting form reads as a recognisable silhouette before dissolving back into abstract wisps, with a thin accent line tracing alongside it like a flight path.
build: A fluid/smoke simulation (stable-fluids solver or curl-noise advected particles as overlapping soft strokes) driven toward a target silhouette mask at its peak-legibility frame, then released back to free drift. The accent line is a separate hand-eased path so it stays crisp against the organic smoke.
sound: A very soft, low whoosh under the plume's motion, nothing sharp or percussive.
prompt: Animate a monochrome plume of smoke or ink billowing across the frame, drifting through a moment where it reads as a recognisable silhouette before dissolving back into abstraction, with a single thin accent line tracing alongside it like a path.
